description: This file declares the interface for the GenericPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create various player tasks related to media playback, such as attaching samples, handling bus messages, and setting playback parameters. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and interacts with GStreamer components and media pipeline objects.

classes.name: GenericPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating various media player tasks related to GStreamer-based media playback, such as attaching samples, handling bus messages, and adjusting playback parameters.
